en: The image depicts a large, ornate, historic European building in a neoclassical or late 19th-century architectural style. The scene shows a corner building with arched windows on the ground floor, columns and decorative window frames on the upper floors, and a mansard-style roof. Trees, lamp posts, and a quiet street surround the structure. The photograph is black and white, suggesting it is from an early 20th-century period or before. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side shown.
